$comment: Google Maps Platform pricing for the location services Zonatic compares against.
Prices are Google's published global list prices in USD, per 1,000 billable events.
Billing model: Google aggregates usage monthly across all projects on the billing
account, applies the free usage cap first, then charges each volume band at that
band's own rate (progressive, never one flat rate for the whole volume). Google's
worked example on the pricing page confirms this: 200,000 Autocomplete Requests
resolve as 10,000 free, then 90,000 @ $2.83, then 100,000 @ $2.27, totalling $481.70.
IMPORTANT: these prices are per SKU and vary with the fields/field mask a request
asks for. Google Places API (New) has no single price. Only the SKUs listed here are
modelled, and each is labelled with its exact SKU so the UI never implies that all
of Places API costs this much.

source.note: Global list price. Google reserves the right to grant additional volume discounts, which are not modelled here.

places_text_search_pro.displayName: Google Places API — Text Search Pro
notes: Text Search (New) billed as a Pro SKU. Price depends on the field mask requested, so a request that asks for more fields can cost more than this figure.
Nearby Search, Place Details, and Enterprise SKUs are deliberately not modelled yet.
Geocoding Essentials SKU. Autocomplete Requests was removed from this comparison; the schema still accepts it if it comes back.
